name: VolMon
tagline: Native APFS Volume Analyzer, Top 50 Folder Ring Gauge, External Offload, Archive & Git Worktree Suite
short_description: Native macOS APFS drive analyzer with interactive Top 50 Non-Overlapping Folder Ring Gauge & Sunburst, accurate POSIX FTS physical footprints, APFS purgeable space telemetry, boot-first progressive volume scanning, unified per-page Volume Switcher, symlink & clone deduplication, non-blocking Git & worktree manager, direct-streaming compressed backup & archive builder, external storage offload planner, cloud storage hydration guard, 3-column storage flow map, and Low Effort Suite theme & Dock icon sync.
spotlight_description: VolMon v2.1.0 brings an interactive Top 50 Non-Overlapping Folder Ring Gauge & Concentric Sunburst explorer, accurate POSIX FTS physical block footprints, real-time APFS purgeable space telemetry, and boot-first progressive volume scanning to macOS. Switch between Sunburst (Parent Roots + Top 50 Exclusive Folders), Single Ring, and Parent Roots views with instant drill-down filtering, switch active volumes across every action page so already-offloaded folders are protected from duplicate offload actions, inspect mounted volumes with symlink & APFS clone deduplication, manage Git repositories and linked worktrees non-blockingly, stream compressed .tar.gz/.zip archives directly to external drives while reclaiming local SSD space, guard against unwanted CloudStorage hydration (iCloud, OneDrive, Google Drive, Dropbox), and sync themes & persistent Dock icons across PerfMon, EventMon, VolMon, and WebMon.
catalog_description: Native macOS APFS volume analyzer, Top 50 Non-Overlapping Folder Ring Gauge & Sunburst explorer, Git worktree manager, external storage offload planner, compressed backup archive builder, and smart cleanup suite engineered in Swift 6. Features an interactive concentric Sunburst & Top 50 exclusive folder ring gauge, accurate POSIX FTS physical block accounting, APFS purgeable space telemetry, boot-first progressive volume scanning, a unified Volume Switcher on every page with already-offloaded folder guards, homogenized tactile LowEffortButtonStyle controls, active-display multi-monitor widget placement, symlink & APFS clone deduplication, non-blocking Git worktree discovery & pruning, direct-streaming .tar.gz/.zip archives with automatic local SSD reclamation, default-off CloudStorage provider tree guards, 3-column Storage Flow Map, and 8-style desktop HUD Cards.
